aggregate_trace_and_dispositions: Shell::new validates mesh and material, rejects empty geometry, derives particles/masses and stretch/seam/bend incidence from the same mesh, reorders bend weights by the same compiled incidence before attachment. Private SurfaceContacts retains original topology. Public triangles/particles/material can later diverge; deduplicated exact RIG-ADMISSION03-F083 (and particle-buffer F082), no duplicate finding.

apply_material explicitly synchronizes compliance and self-collision radius; masses are documented as baked and require rebuild. Cloth fabric edit question remains an explicit caller synchronization contract, not automatic material propagation.

Host-contact schedule snapshots positions for each configured interval, completes a partial final interval, zero schedule waits for submitted work; collision hooks run around constraints intentionally. Bounded projection can end at pass limit; no universal convergence guarantee inferred. read_mesh uses public triangle indices as F083 already records.

Topology::build derives one sorted undirected edge list and exactly-two-face hinges from triangle adjacency; nonmanifold edges retain stretch only by explicit policy. BendQuad particle order matches bending_weights hinge/wing order. vertex_masses derives one value per supplied position and distributes each triangle share; caller mesh index/finite admission remains upstream rather than proven by this raw utility.

bending_weights rejects collapsed/null-space degeneracy, returns four weights with shared normalization and area scale; documented resolution retuning prevents inferring full resolution independence. Tests personally read as contract examples, not executed.

BEND reads four particle indices and eight-float padded weight record, first/count dispatch from SolveParams; host Shell uses same incidence reorder before flattening. Magnitude-zero returns explicitly.

Self-collision hash and search use identical cell/hash functions, retain exact cell comparison to reject hash collisions, exclude mesh-connected neighbors, weight corrections by inverse mass, and use antisymmetric fallback for coincident points. Pinned particles skip. Fixed-point corrections accumulated separately then averaged by contributor count and atomically reset per pass; overflow/quantization are documented numerical limits, no universal exactness claim or ordinary overflow witness.
CELL_RANGES and CLEAR_RANGES use table_size+1 end marker; exact host allocation/dispatch authority remains required for cross-module relation, not discharged by shader body alone.
